### Research SWE (HCI × Generative AI) — Python/LLM/UX Evaluation

> Research engineer focused on HCI and Creativity Support Tools using foundation models.
> I design user studies, measurement methods, prototype, and evaluate interactive systems end-to-end —- from machine learning/LLM agents backends to user interfaces frontend -— then drive findings into academic output and productization.

- **Keywords**: Human-AI Interaction, Music and HCI (Interactive System on Musical Experience), Natural Language Processing
